title: Interview with Nico van der Woude, Kasteel Amerongen, 16 January 2026
descriptions: Nico van der Woude is interviewed about his work as a conservator-restorer of historic interiors and an architectural finishes researcher. In the first half he discusses his education and training, his work in various interior projects in the Netherlands, conservation education in the Netherlands, and the peculiarities of working as an interiors conservator. In the second half he discusses the interview's setting, Kasteel Amerongen, including his work there as curator, conservation interventions, and the history of the house.
